ai.title: Reorder suggest-prompts nudge after to-do nudge and extend to CLI
ai.summary: The agent runtime now checks for unanswered follow-up cards only after the to-do progress nudge has fired, ensuring that an unfinished task list takes priority over requesting a written answer from the model. The `endsOnSuggestPromptsBeforeAnswer` utility in `packages/agent-runtime` is extended to recognize both `suggest_prompts` and `suggest_followups` tool calls by checking against the shared `FOLLOWUP_SUGGESTION_TOOL_NAMES` set, making the guard effective for CLI sessions that use the `suggest_followups` tool.
ai.evidence: In `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts`, the `endsOnSuggestPromptsBeforeAnswer` check is moved below the `decideFollowupTodoNudge` block, and in `packages/agent-runtime/src/util/suggest-prompts-before-answer.ts`, the tool name comparison is replaced with `FOLLOWUP_SUGGESTION_TOOL_NAMES.has()` to cover both `suggest_prompts` and `suggest_followups`.

eli5.text: The assistant now checks if your to-do list is finished before asking you to write a final answer. Previously, it would jump to the suggestion step even if tasks were still open; now, unfinished work takes priority, so the assistant goes back to work instead of ending the conversation early. This internal adjustment ensures that the CLI interface handles follow-up suggestions the same way the desktop app does, keeping the flow consistent across all apps. You will notice that the assistant is less likely to stop and ask for your input while a task is still in progress.
